release_notes: Mail merge text starts regular, and a 3.54 recipe stays regular unless bold is turned on. Loading an imposition recipe clears leftover mail-merge fields and opens the last step. A JSON recipe can be dropped onto the window. Large PDFs keep their own resolution. Build and Save can set a max resolution: Original, 300, 600, or 1200. Add Files and Load Recipe remember separate folders. Each mail merge field can be rotated.
